svg.title: An OAM link with identical transmit and receive arrays
svg.desc: A uniform circular array of eight elements, fed with a phase that steps around the ring, launches a beam whose phase front twists like a corkscrew. The transmitter radius a is chosen so that the main lobe at the receiver, 50 or 100 m away at 26 GHz, lands on a ring of the same radius b = a.
